en.headline: Police arrest two over suspected counterfeit US dollar notes at North Point bank
en.dek: A man and a woman were detained after Bank of China staff flagged 100 US$100 bills at a branch on King's Road on Friday morning.
body: Police arrested a 68-year-old man and a 38-year-old woman on Friday morning after staff at a Bank of China branch in North Point reported suspected counterfeit US dollar notes.

The pair, both mainland residents holding dual-entry permits, attended the branch at 131 King's Road around 11:47 a.m. and presented 100 notes of US$100 denomination for deposit or account opening, according to police and local reports.
Staff noticed irregularities, including 88 notes sharing one serial number and 12 sharing another, and called police. Officers arrived and arrested the two on suspicion of uttering counterfeit notes.

Under section 99 of the Crimes Ordinance, a person who utters a counterfeit banknote knowing or believing it to be counterfeit is liable on conviction to up to 14 years' imprisonment. The case has been handed to the Eastern District crime unit for further investigation.
Police have not named the arrested pair. No further details on the origin of the notes have been released.

zh.headline: 北角中銀職員揭百張百元美鈔疑偽鈔 警拘兩人
zh.dek: 一男一女今早持100張100美元鈔票到英皇道分行，職員發現多張同編號後報警，兩人涉行使偽鈔被捕。
body: 警方周五上午拘捕一名68歲男子及一名38歲女子，涉嫌在北角中國銀行分行行使偽製紙幣。
據報，兩人同為持雙程證的內地居民，約上午11時47分到英皇道131號分行，交上100張面值100美元的鈔票，擬存款或開戶。
職員發現其中88張編號相同、另12張編號亦相同，懷疑是偽鈔，遂報警。警員到場後以涉嫌行使偽製紙幣拘捕兩人。
根據《刑事罪行條例》第99條，明知或相信紙幣屬偽製而將其當作真品行使者，一經定罪最高可判監禁14年。案件交由東區刑事調查隊跟進。
警方暫未公布被捕人姓名，亦未交代鈔票來源。
